entries.name: door
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: flat Minecraft Java block texture draft for the Frozen Dawn mod. Strict coarse Minecraft pixel art: crisp square pixels, restricted palette, no antialiasing, no gradients, no perspective, no rendered cube, no scene, no illustration backdrop, no text or watermark. Materials: worn charcoal steel, cool gray metal, slight desaturated blue seams matching ORSA survival equipment. Produce an enlarged nearest-neighbor-looking texture sprite sheet on solid neutral dark gray. Keep surfaces readable at Minecraft's native resolution. These are texture design drafts, not a photorealistic presentation. Subject: one industrial airtight door, one block wide and two blocks tall. Show its single straight-on 16-by-32 logical-pixel front face, centered and large; upper 16x16 half contains a small square reinforced cyan glass window with a dark border. Lower 16x16 half has a simple inset solid steel panel. Four restrained rivets, dark rubber seal along the edges, a small right-side mechanical latch. Top and bottom halves align perfectly. Thick steel frame, sturdy vanilla iron-door-compatible silhouette. No extra objects, no labels, no duplicate doors. Flat front texture only, not a physical door render.

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: flat Minecraft Java block texture draft for the Frozen Dawn mod. Strict coarse Minecraft pixel art: crisp square pixels, restricted palette, no antialiasing, no gradients, no perspective, no rendered cube, no scene, no illustration backdrop, no text or watermark. Materials: worn charcoal steel, cool gray metal, slight desaturated blue seams matching ORSA survival equipment. Produce an enlarged nearest-neighbor-looking texture sprite sheet on solid neutral dark gray. Keep surfaces readable at Minecraft's native resolution. These are texture design drafts, not a photorealistic presentation. Subject: one airlock controller block texture sheet. Four equal square texture tiles arranged horizontally with clear dark space between them. First three are IDENTICAL flat front panels except status lamp color: first red, second amber, third green. Each front uses an exact-looking 16x16 logical pixel grid: steel edge, dark inset control area, tiny oxygen gauge shown by simple cyan squares, small button, and a highly readable small lamp at upper right. Fourth tile is the plain matching steel casing used for side/top/back faces, also 16x16 logical pixels. No words, no numbers, no labeled UI, no door, no valve, no perspective. Make colors the only difference between the three controller fronts.
